stream_sentences.text: Solar wind parameters reflected the initial onset of positive polarity CH HSS influences.
The solar wind environment is expected to remain weakly enhanced due to positive polarity CH HSS influences on 28-29 Nov.
The geomagnetic field is expected to be at quiet to active levels on 28 Nov, and quiet to unsettled on 29 Nov, due to positive polarity CH HSS influences.
